mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, increasing perphenazine plasma concentrations and risk of adverse effects; both drugs prolong QT interval and have anticholinergic properties.
action: Monitor for increased perphenazine toxicity (extrapyramidal symptoms, anticholinergic effects, arrhythmias); consider alternative antibiotic or reduce perphenazine dose; obtain baseline and follow-up ECGs.
